marking_points.quote: The concept behind the Misuse Detection Systems (MDSs) is that there are ways to represent attacks in the form of a pattern or a signature so that even variations of the same attack can be detected.

marking_points.point: State Transition Analysis presents the monitored system as a state transition diagram where transitions occur on boolean conditions.

marking_points.point: IDS strengths include verifying attack success by reviewing HIDS log entries and conducting forensic analysis.

marking_points.point: Keystroke monitoring is a simple technique that monitors keystrokes for attack patterns, though it has limitations with shell aliases.
